An iOS-style wheel picker with inertia scrolling and infinite loop, with a shadcn-styled wrapper.

Source: [react-wheel-picker](https://github.com/ncdai/react-wheel-picker) by ncdai — MIT.

Ships as an npm library, with a shadcn/ui wrapper documented on the site.

```bash
npm install @ncdai/react-wheel-picker
```
